name: Thompson Valley
terms: Vintners Quality Alliance, the appellation system for Canadian wine from British Columbia and Ontario. It guarantees the wine's origin.
Made from grapes frozen naturally on the vine and picked at ⟦temp|18°F|−8°C⟧ or colder. Canada makes more than any other country, over 90% of it in Ontario.
